audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was built on 'Stormbringer's shield' in three places (whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid). Riot's text gives Stormbringer bonus Health, not a shield — the shield in Volibear's kit is Sky Splitter's, and only if he stands in the blast.
audit.why: A player expecting a shield will trade as though he has burst absorption he does not have; bonus health behaves differently against Wuju Style's true damage in particular.
audit.corrected: Stormbringer grants bonus health, a 550-range leap on 160s at rank 1, and disables towers near the landing point. Master Yi's Highlander is 85s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said 'Highlander's slow-immunity kites your stun window'. Riot's text makes him immune to slowing effects only — it does nothing to a stun. What it actually invalidates is Sky Splitter's slow. Two real interactions were also missing entirely: Meditate is a channel (his own text counts the seconds he channels), and Alpha Strike makes him untargetable on a 20s rank-1 cooldown that his basic attacks shorten.
audit.why: Believing Highlander beats the stun makes a Volibear refuse the one commit that wins the fight. Knowing it only beats the slow tells him to open with Thundering Smash and treat Sky Splitter as a self-shield in that window.
audit.corrected: Highlander (85s) grants slow immunity, not stun immunity; Meditate is an interruptible channel; Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1, untargetable, and shortened by his attacks.

audit.why: Meditate and his sustain make Grievous Wounds genuinely valuable here, and the content layer does not claim otherwise. Nothing to correct without a full layer to write itemization into.
